# Hyperliquid SDK · Bloxwap

> @bloxwap/hyperliquid is an open-source (MIT) TypeScript and JavaScript SDK for the Hyperliquid exchange API. It provides typed clients for market data (Info), trading (Exchange), real-time streams (Subscription/WebSocket), and explorer data, over HTTP or WebSocket transports, on Bun, Node.js, browsers, and React Native. Maintained by Bloxwap, Inc. and published on npm.

## When to use this SDK

Reach for this SDK when the task is to:

- Read Hyperliquid market data (mids, order books, candles, funding) or account state from TypeScript/JavaScript.
- Place, modify, or cancel Hyperliquid orders, manage vaults, or sign exchange actions with a wallet.
- Subscribe to real-time market or account updates with automatic reconnection.
- Build a trading bot, dashboard, or agent that calls the Hyperliquid API programmatically.

Do not use it for non-Hyperliquid exchanges, or for custody of user funds; signing keys stay with the caller.

## How an agent should use this site

- Every documentation page has a Markdown mirror: append `.md` to the page path without its trailing slash (for example `/hyperliquid/docs/clients/` becomes `/hyperliquid/docs/clients.md`).
- `llms-full.txt` contains the entire documentation as one Markdown file.
- The npm package README doubles as the quick-start: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@bloxwap/hyperliquid

## Documentation (Markdown)

- [Documentation overview](https://bloxwap.github.io/hyperliquid/docs.md): SDK capabilities and install
- [Connect to Hyperliquid (transports)](https://bloxwap.github.io/hyperliquid/docs/transports.md): HTTP and WebSocket transports, endpoints, timeouts
- [Clients](https://bloxwap.github.io/hyperliquid/docs/clients.md): Info, Exchange, Subscription, and Explorer clients
- [Error handling](https://bloxwap.github.io/hyperliquid/docs/error-handling.md): typed errors and retries
- [Signing](https://bloxwap.github.io/hyperliquid/docs/signing.md): wallets, EIP-712 action signing
- [Utilities](https://bloxwap.github.io/hyperliquid/docs/utilities.md): helpers for prices, sizes, and symbols
- [Guides](https://bloxwap.github.io/hyperliquid/docs/guides.md): task-focused walkthroughs
- [Agent wallets and vaults](https://bloxwap.github.io/hyperliquid/docs/guides/agent-wallets-and-vaults.md): delegated signing for agents
- [Browser wallets](https://bloxwap.github.io/hyperliquid/docs/guides/browser-wallets.md): connect MetaMask-style wallets
- [Market orders](https://bloxwap.github.io/hyperliquid/docs/guides/market-orders.md): place market orders correctly
- [Tree-shaking](https://bloxwap.github.io/hyperliquid/docs/guides/tree-shaking.md): minimal bundles
- [Reference](https://bloxwap.github.io/hyperliquid/docs/reference.md): API reference notes
- [Known documentation drift](https://bloxwap.github.io/hyperliquid/docs/reference/known-drift.md): where the API differs from its docs
